# Exponent

> > Exponent is a comprehensive interview preparation platform offering AI-powered mock interviews and peer-to-peer practice for tech roles across product, engineering, data science, and management.

Exponent provides interview coaching and practice tools for candidates preparing for roles at major tech companies including Google, Meta, and Microsoft. The platform combines AI feedback, peer mentorship, and structured interview practice to help professionals advance their careers.

## Key Topics

- Mock Interviews
- Interview Prep
- Product Management
- Software Engineering
- Data Science
- Engineering Management
- AI Interviewer
- Behavioral Interviews
- Coding Interviews
- Peer-to-Peer Learning
- Career Advancement
- Tech Interview Preparation
- AI Feedback
- Job Search
- Mentorship

## Core Platform

- [Exponent Home](https://www.tryexponent.com): Main landing page for Exponent's interview prep platform covering product, engineering, data science, and management roles
- [Mock Interviews](https://www.tryexponent.com/practice): Practice mock interviews with AI interviewer and peer feedback to improve interview performance across all tech roles
